title: Entity header
responsibility: Shows entity identity and one tab bar for overview, contract, usage, states or tests, history and optional source.

inputs.name: EntityHeader.entity
inputs.description: Required identity, category, role, purpose and verdict. Page headers keep identity concise; purpose and app route remain in Contract.

inputs.name: EntityHeader.nav
inputs.description: The branch, commit and selected tab, with functions for links and navigation.

inputs.name: EntityHeader.shared
inputs.description: Optional flag, false by default, displaying a Shared badge.

inputs.name: EntityHeader.preview
inputs.description: Optional component screenshot shown above every tab.

inputs.name: EntityHeader.owner
inputs.description: Sole recorded consumer for a private function breadcrumb; absent when ownership is unknown or not unique.

outputs.name: EntityHeader
outputs.description: Entity identity, verification and one tab bar. Pages omit Used In, purpose prose and route metadata. Component screenshots remain above tabs. Private function breadcrumbs identify their recorded owner and never link to Helpers.
